title: Identification of $i^!$ with sections with support
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$. Let $X,Z$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes in the standing setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of $k$-schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite inside a fixed algebraic closure $\Qlb$, and let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$, with the pulled-back condensed module-object coefficients and bounded constructible categories $\Dbc(-,\Lambda)$ of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Write $\mathcal C_T=\Loc(\Dbc(T,\Lambda))$ for the full localizing subcategory of the ambient unbounded category $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$, as in [sk-def-localizing-closure]; here $\Dbc=\Dctf$ by [sk-lem-coefficient-heart]. Let $i^!:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal C_Z$ be the right adjoint of $Ri_!=i_*$ on these localizing categories [sk-prop-sf-existence], with the closed-immersion normalization $Ri_!=i_*$ understood as part of this adjunction. Let $R\underline\Gamma_Z$ be the derived sections-with-support functor of [sk-lem-formal-closed-support]. For every $K\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ there is an isomorphism
$$i^!K\simeq R\underline\Gamma_ZK$$
in $\mathcal C_Z$, natural in $K$ and compatible with the counits $i_*i^!K\to K$ and $i_*R\underline\Gamma_ZK\to K$.

proof.text: Use localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc on X and Z, with the given coefficient isomorphism. Its Dctf=Dbc equality and the defining intersection of localizingClosureProEtale put every bounded constructible object in the localizing closure. Apply rationalClosedSupportConstructible for the finite constant model notion to put the support value in Dbc(Z). For a coefficient isomorphism, restriction of scalars is an exact equivalence preserving and reflecting finite constant models and bounded cohomology. The closed-direct-image coefficient square conjugates the two left adjoints; uniqueness of right adjoints identifies the corresponding derived support functors. This transports support constructibility to the stated arbitrary isomorphic coefficient ring. Use the general finite-constant-model coefficient transport lemmas from lem-sfb-condensed-coefficient-iso-constructible: forward restriction preserves constructibility, while restriction along the inverse and the comap composition isomorphism reflect it. The exact homology comparison then gives bounded constructibility in both directions. No integral heart-closure assertion is used.

Derive the finite-colimit-preservation instance for the closed direct image from closedSupport_lowerStarExact, using the open complement. For a localizing object A and bounded constructible K, form alpha by the exceptional adjunction inverse Hom equivalence, fullness of the inclusion on X, and precomposition with closed.inv.app A. Form beta by fullness of the inclusion on Z and the support adjunction inverse Hom equivalence. Both are bijections to Hom(i_*A,K). Naturality in A follows from the adjunction Hom equivalences and naturality of closed.inv.

Apply Mathlib Yoneda.ext to beta inverse composed with alpha and its inverse. The inverse identities are the equivalence inverse identities, and naturality in A was checked in the preceding step. This constructs theta_K as an isomorphism in the full localizing subcategory. Evaluate the composite Hom equivalence at the identity: beta(theta_K)=alpha(identity). Expanding the Hom equivalences yields exactly i_*(theta_K) followed by the support counit equal to closed.inv followed by the exceptional counit.

For q:K→K′ prove that alpha and beta commute with postcomposition by q, using adjunction naturality in the right variable. Apply injectivity of beta to the two candidate naturality composites. The identity beta(theta)=alpha(identity), naturality in A, and postcomposition naturality make their images equal. NatIso.ofComponents packages theta into the required natural isomorphism; the identity just proved gives its stated counit compatibility.

theorem closedAdjointConstructibleYoneda
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ)
    {X Z U : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [i.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ)
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (_hΛ : Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E)) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ)))
    (c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification i)
    (h : ∀ K, localizingClosureProEtale Λ Z K → localizingClosureProEtale Λ X
      ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c.obj.obj).obj K))
    (G : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (localizingClosureProEtale Λ Z).FullSubcategory)
    (adj : localizingLowerShriek Λ c.obj.obj h ⊣ G) :
    letI := closedSupport_lowerStarExact Λ i j hij
    ∀ (closed : localizingLowerShriek Λ c.obj.obj h ⋙ (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).ι ≅
      (localizingClosureProEtale Λ Z).ι ⋙ (lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory)
      (support : FormalClosedSupportAssertions Λ i j hij),
    ∃ (hK : ∀ K : ConstantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X,
        localizingClosureProEtale Λ X K.obj)
      (hS : ∀ K : ConstantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X,
        localizingClosureProEtale Λ Z
          ((formalClosedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K.obj)),
      ∃ e :
        ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).lift
          (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X).ι hK) ⋙ G ≅
        (localizingClosureProEtale Λ Z).lift
          ((constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X).ι ⋙
            (formalClosedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctor) hS,
        ∀ K : ConstantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X,
          (lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.map
              ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ Z).ι.map (e.hom.app K)) ≫
            support.rightAdjoint.counit.app K.obj =
          closed.inv.app (G.obj (((localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).lift
            (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X).ι hK).obj K)) ≫
            (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).ι.map
              (adj.counit.app (((localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).lift
                (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X).ι hK).obj K))
